contexts.text: Wilt Thou spare it for fifty righteous? () = intercession from love.
I will spare it for those () = that they will be saved.
The faithful think they should be spared on account of the good which they have done; and, if they were spared, they would glory...
The continual avoidance of evils and falsities is signified by, thine eye shall not spare them ().
Falsity destroying good, is meant by a man shall not spare his brother ().
Spare ye not her young men () = the destruction of confirmed falsities.
Their eye shall not spare sons () = that their perverted understanding will devastate all the truth of the Church. AE 724:15.
